calls.title: Growthbook <> ClickHouse React SDK setup check
calls.summary: The team discussed the persistent problem of multiple variant exposures in Growth Book experiments due to inconsistent user identifiers used for traffic splitting and analysis. Jeremy Dorn identified that different identifiers like `user_id`, `User ID`, and `Galaxy ID` are causing confusion and recommended standardizing on explicit IDs while removing any auto-generated identifiers. The group agreed to clean up existing ID logic, ensuring stable identifiers are used to minimize tracking errors. Jeremy also explained the careful process needed to reset experiments, emphasizing the importance of setting start dates correctly to avoid skewed data. Furthermore, the team acknowledged the benefits of consolidating metrics into fact tables for improved query efficiency and discussed a dual-ID strategy for tracking users in Auth0 environments. Next steps included cleanup of ID usage and coordination with the data warehouse team for better metrics queries.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, user_id, multiple exposure, experiment setup, auto attributes plugin, fact tables
